rule.description: More than one production function embeds the anatomy of a store identity scheme of sorl-thumbnail directly in its own body: (sub-relation A) assembling or dismantling the composite raw store key built from the configured key prefix and the `||` separator, or (sub-relation B) computing the salt-joined MD5 digest that identifies an image or thumbnail. Any conceptual change to either scheme must then be repeated in each of those functions; each function is an independent copy of one shared responsibility.

checks.description: Detect functions that assemble or dismantle the composite raw store key (configured prefix plus `||`-separated record identity and record key) inline instead of delegating to a single shared owner.
checks.detected_relation: function -> inline composite raw store key anatomy (prefix reference and `||` separator constant in the same function body)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The raw-key layout is one responsibility of the store layer; each inlining function is a separate master of the layout, so a conceptual key-scheme change must be edited into every one of them.

matches.evidence: Reads records with self._get_raw('%s||%s||%s' % (settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX, identity, key)), rebuilding the composite raw key locally.
Writes records with the raw key built by an inline '||'.join([settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX, identity, key]).
Deletes records using an inline f-string containing settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX, the `||` separator and the record key.
Scans with an inline identity-scoped prefix (settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX + '||' + identity + '||') and dismantles each raw key with raw_key.split('||')[-1].
Bulk clear enumerates raw keys with the inline composite prefix settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX + '||' instead of the layout-agnostic prefix.
The database+cache bulk purge matches both cache entries and key-value rows against an inline settings.THUMBNAIL_KEY_PREFIX + '||' scheme fragment.

checks.description: Detect functions that compute the salt-joined MD5 record-identity digest inline (separator constant plus digest call in the same body) instead of delegating to a single shared owner.
checks.detected_relation: function -> inline record identity digest (MD5 call over `||`-separated salt parts)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The identity digest format is one responsibility shared by source identity and thumbnail naming; each inlining function is a separate master of the digest, so a conceptual identity-scheme change must be edited into every one of them.

matches.evidence: The source image identity property builds its own salt with the `||` separator and hashes it with an inline hashlib.md5(...) call.
The destination filename derivation builds its own `||`-joined salt over the source identity, geometry and options and hashes it with an inline hashlib.md5(...) call.

clean_and_repaired_reference_owners: sorl/thumbnail/kvstores/base.py:add_prefix (sub-relation A) — single owner of the raw-key layout in clean and canonical repaired states
sorl/thumbnail/helpers.py:tokey (sub-relation B) — single owner of the identity digest in clean and canonical repaired states

excluded.reason: These backends receive fully composed keys and only glob-match, encode bytes or persist; they embed no prefix or separator anatomy of the scheme, so the same rule does not detect them.

excluded.candidate: retina variant suffix naming duplicated between ThumbnailBackend._create_alternative_resolutions and the `resolution` template filter
excluded.reason: Directory-side `@Nx` naming is a different scheme (filename variant suffixes) that predates the injected history; it is neither prefixed with the key prefix nor digested, so the rule does not detect it.
Walks the thumbnail filename prefix on the filesystem; references the filename prefix, not the key prefix, and contains no separator anatomy.
Persistence mapping of the configured database column name; contains no key-scheme assembly.
Single-owner filename anatomy retained in clean, injected and repaired states; only the digest sub-relation inside this function participates in the smell.
